recipes.title: Pudim de Leite Condensado
recipes.description: Traditional Brazilian caramel flan baked in a water bath until silky smooth.
instructions: Melt sugar in a saucepan over medium heat until golden amber to form the caramel.
Pour caramel into a 20cm ring mold, coating the bottom and sides evenly.
Whisk condensed milk, whole milk, and eggs in a bowl until fully smooth.
Pour mixture into caramel-lined mold and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in a water bath at 180°C for 60 minutes until set.
Chill in refrigerator for at least 4 hours before unmolding.

recipes.title: Moqueca de Palmito e Cogumelos
recipes.description: Fragrant Brazilian coconut stew made with hearts of palm, mushrooms, and dende oil.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until fragrant.
Add bell pepper, diced tomatoes, hearts of palm, and mushrooms to the pan.
Pour in coconut milk and dende oil, stirring gently to combine.
Simmer covered on low heat for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro before serving hot.

recipes.title: Classic Caprese Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Cold pasta tossed with ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, basil, and garlic olive oil.
instructions: Boil penne pasta in salted water until al dente; drain and rinse with cold water.
Whisk olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper in a large mixing bowl.
Add chilled pasta, cherry tomatoes, and mozzarella to the dressing.
Toss ingredients gently and chill in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and fresh basil before serving.

recipes.title: Avocado Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing, protein-rich salad loaded with chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and herbs.
instructions: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Combine chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and cilantro in a salad bowl.
Toss with dressing, then fold in diced avocado carefully.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Keto Cauliflower Fried Rice
recipes.description: Low-carb garlic fried rice made with tender riced cauliflower and scrambled eggs.
instructions: Heat half the sesame oil in a wok and scramble beaten eggs until set; set aside.
Add remaining oil and sauté garlic, carrots, and peas for 3 minutes.
Add riced cauliflower and sauté over high heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, scrambled eggs, and sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato & Basil Soup
recipes.description: Rich tomato soup simmered with garlic, butter, and cream, finished with fresh basil.
instructions: Melt butter in a pot and sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add diced tomatoes and vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered on medium-low heat for 20 minutes.
Blend soup until smooth using an immersion blender.
Stir in heavy cream and fresh basil, seasoning with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Traditional Brazilian Feijoada
recipes.description: Iconic Brazilian black bean stew slow-simmered with salted beef, pork, and bacon.
instructions: Boil soaked black beans in a large stockpot with bay leaves and orange halves.
In a skillet, sauté bacon, sausage, pork shoulder, and salted beef until browned.
Transfer meats to the bean pot and simmer on low heat for 2.5 hours.
Sauté onion and garlic in bacon fat until golden, then mash a cup of beans into the paste.
Stir garlic-bean paste back into the main pot to thicken sauce; simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Feijão Tropeiro
recipes.description: Hearty Brazilian miner's dish with beans, cassava flour, crispy bacon, and eggs.
instructions: Fry diced bacon and sausage in a large skillet until crispy; set meats aside.
Scramble eggs in the remaining fat in the skillet until soft; set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, and collard greens in olive oil until greens wilt.
Add cooked beans, bacon, sausage, and scrambled eggs back into skillet.
Gradually toss in cassava flour while stirring until well combined and toasted.

recipes.title: Brazilian Coxinha
recipes.description: Teardrop-shaped croquettes stuffed with seasoned shredded chicken and cream cheese.
ingredients: 100g Brazilian cream cheese (catupiry or cream cheese)
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic, add shredded chicken, season well, and mix with cream cheese.
Boil chicken broth and butter in a saucepan; add flour all at once and stir to form dough.
Knead dough on a clean surface once cool enough to handle.
Shape dough into small cups, fill with chicken mix, and pinch top into a teardrop.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes or deep fry until golden brown.

recipes.title: Brazilian Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Tender beef strips in a creamy tomato-mustard sauce with mushrooms.
instructions: Melt butter in a pan and sear beef strips on high heat; remove and set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, and sliced mushrooms in the same skillet until soft.
Add diced tomatoes, ketchup, and mustard; simmer for 5 minutes.
Return beef to pan, stir in heavy cream, and simmer on low heat for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Pork Carnitas
recipes.description: Juicy citrus and garlic marinated pork shoulder roasted until fork-tender and crispy.
ingredients: 1.5kg pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
instructions: Rub pork chunks with garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, and olive oil.
Place pork, chopped onion, orange juice, and lime juice in a roasting pan.
Cover tightly with foil and roast at 150°C for 3.5 hours until tender.
Shred pork with two forks and broil on a baking sheet for 5 minutes until edges crisp.

recipes.title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breasts marinated in citrus, olive oil, garlic, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Whisk olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Marinate chicken breasts in the mixture for at least 30 minutes in the fridge.
Preheat outdoor grill or cast-iron skillet to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Chili
recipes.description: Hearty ground beef chili cooked with kidney beans, diced tomatoes, and warm spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil and brown ground beef with onion and garlic in a pot.
Add chili powder, cumin, diced tomatoes, and kidney beans.
Bring mixture to a gentle boil, then turn heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 35 minutes until chili thickens.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Dill Butter
recipes.description: Flaky salmon fillets baked with garlic-dill butter and fresh lemon slices.
instructions: Whisk softened butter, garlic, and chopped fresh dill together.
Place salmon fillets on a lined baking sheet and brush with olive oil.
Spread garlic-dill butter over fillets and top with lemon slices.
Bake at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

recipes.title: Roast Herb-Crusted Lamb Rack
recipes.description: Tender lamb rack seared and roasted with garlic, rosemary, and breadcrumbs.
instructions: Sear lamb rack in a hot skillet with olive oil for 2 minutes per side; remove.
Brush cooked side of lamb with Dijon mustard.
Mix breadcrumbs, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper; press onto mustard coating.
Roast at 200°C for 20 minutes for medium-rare.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Easy oven-roasted chicken breast strips, sliced bell peppers, and onions.
instructions: Place chicken, bell peppers, onion, and diced tomatoes on a large baking sheet.
Toss ingredients with olive oil, minced garlic, chili powder, and cumin.
Spread in a single layer and roast at 210°C for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
